classification: original candidate requiring qualified coaching review

rules.completion: Every assigned workout must have a current completed outcome with comparable actual total and running duration at least the prescribed duration.
rules.feedback: Every current outcome must report comfortable difficulty, no unusual fatigue and no discomfort. RPE is retained as evidence but no numerical RPE threshold is applied.
rules.health: Any historical pain concern preserves a review hold, including corrected or removed outcomes. No clearance mechanism is authorized here.
rules.confirmation: Current capability must be explicitly reconfirmed after the last workout and no later than evaluation. A new block must start after the original block and all actual outcomes.
rules.interruption: A new interruption requires reassessment; elapsed calendar time never establishes successful completion.
rules.actualSequence: Actual dates must not precede the block, must retain assignment order, and must satisfy the referenced foundation minimum rest-day rule. Otherwise review is required; no automatic make-up sessions.
rules.transformation: Recalculate only through the exact existing foundation policy from independently confirmed current capability; never increase workload automatically from completion.
rules.continuousTransition: A previously walk-run block may transition to continuous foundation only when confirmed current continuous capability supports every newly generated running segment without recovery breaks.
rules.unsupported: Automatic repetition, regression, aerobic-base and race-preparation transitions require separate authored rules. Return policy_gap.

evidence.limitations: Completion and self-report do not establish injury safety, medical clearance or race readiness. These categorical decisions are not published coaching prescriptions.

releaseBlockers: Qualified coach review of every decision condition
